findings: The anhydride answer in Quick Check 25.1 goes beyond the book. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.

Figure 25.3 prints an NH3 arrow from ethanol to ethanamide, which is not a real conversion; the redrawn figure leaves it out and the Roman Urdu note explains why. The other reagents are drawn as printed (including V2O5 for aldehyde to acid and H2O, H2SO4 for alkene to alcohol).

Figure 25.4 prints 'benene sulfonic acid'; corrected to 'benzene sulfonic acid'. It makes phenol from benzenesulphonic acid with '(i) NaOH (ii) HCl'; industrially this needs fusion with NaOH at high temperature.
